doc.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023

chapter: From The Lancers to Harry James
title: Joe Venuti and the call to join Harry James at 22
summary: After Southeast Asia tours, Venuti's introduction led Pee Wee Monte to offer Radke the first trumpet chair, and he met Harry in Vegas.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: says, “Well I’m very sorry, my wife usually plays piano but she can’t play piano because she’s ill with the flu.” And I said, “Well you know who this is?” So during the ceremony I stood at the — I guess the altar — and Joe Venuti played piano — he was a very good pianist, and Gina sang at my own wedding. Okay so now we go back to work this big show and there’s about a thousand people and Joe Venuti says, “Tonight you know I get to introduce Gina Funes and Fred Radke. They just got married today” [mumbles]. And everybody applauds. So Gina comes out and does her thing and she’s sensational you know. And I mean really elegant, really something. And so she said, “Tonight is the first night I’m going to get to introduce my conductor to you as my husband, Mr. Fred — Mr. Fred — ” and she couldn’t think of my last name. Well Venuti on the side, Venuti said, “Radke.” So that turns out. So now time goes on, Gina and I go to Southeast Asia during the war and we do two tours over there for private agents. It was just terrible in those days, Thailand and the Philippines. And so I came back and Venuti is in town playing and with Corky Corcoran, who is a famous saxophone player. So I said why don’t we go down — I’ve never met Corky. I mean we know each other, let’s go see Venuti. We haven’t seen him for six months. So we go down and see him and, hey, “Love to see you guys” he says — I said, “What are you doing Joe?” He says, “I’m opening next week with Harry James and Phil Harris in Vegas. Have you ever played with Harry?” And Gina says, “You have to ask him that? That’s all he’s ever wanted to do.” And Joe says, “You don’t — Harry James doesn’t know you?” And I said, “No.” “And you never played with?” I said, “Joe, I told you.” “Oh.” Two days later, “This is Pee Wee Monte from Harry James, we’d like you to join the band, the first trumpet chair is open and when are you available?” I said, “Well I have some commitments.” “We know that. When will you be available?” And then they said, I’ve never been asked this, and they said, “What do you need?” What do I need? I’m thinking. “Well let me tell you what we’re going to pay, we’re offering to pay you, and then we can negotiate it.” Well they came right with a high, good figure and not like what Sonny was making but I — and then when you went to Vegas you worked seven days so your salary was really up there because you got time and time and a half. So here I am now, my dream come true.

23. And I go down — or 22. I go down and I’m there and Harry comes in. And the manager introduces me to Harry. And Harry says, “Yes I know who you are, Fred, you were with The Lancers” because word got around you know. And in the back as I’m standing there shaking Harry James’s hand, Venuti comes in from the back of the showroom and he says, “Hey Harry.” And of course Harry says, “Joe, how are you?” And he says, “It’s about time you hired a trumpet player that plays as good as you.” I thought, timing.
